title: St. Joseph: Terror of Demons
description: A man battling temptation calls on St. Joseph's intercession as an unseen spiritual battle unfolds between light and darkness.

title: The Resurrection – Death Defeated
description: Witness the moment Jesus Christ rises from the tomb in this cinematic animation. Inspired by the Gospels, historical burial practices, and the Shroud of Turin, it offers a reverent portrayal of Christianity's greatest event.

title: The New Ark of the Covenant
description:
Why did King David leap for joy before the Ark of the Covenant, and why did John the Baptist leap in Elizabeth's womb when Mary arrived?

This short animation explores the biblical typology connecting these two remarkable events. By comparing the Old Testament account of David and the Ark with Luke's account of Mary's visit to Elizabeth, the video reveals how Scripture points forward to Christ and presents Mary as the New Ark of the Covenant.
